snippet.title: Minigame Mayhem Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Download Minigame Mayhem:
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/minigame-mayhem/id6477578171
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.FizzelGames.MinigameMayhem

Minigame Mayhem is a game about fast-paced minigames.

With your mobile assistant Kip, you'll tap, drag, and twist your way through 20+ minigames which crank up the speed and difficulty the longer you last.
